socrates: Ah, visitors! Good. I was getting bored of my own opinions.
Come, I have a few questions for you.
plato: Welcome to the Academy, young ones.
Shall we see what you make of a circle?
aristotle: Do keep up, I walk while I talk.
Now, let us look at what is really there.
solon: Sit, children. I have a story from my travels.
Mind it well: it is about a king.
caryatid: Hello, little ones. Look up. Yes, here.
I cannot move my head, but I can talk.
diogenes: Mind my lamp. I am looking for an honest person.
tortoise: Slowly, slowly. I was here first.
Let me tell you about the eagle.
minos: I am Minos, king of Crete. You may bow.
arrephoros: Shh. Come closer. We are not supposed to talk about this.
priestess: Welcome to the house of Athena. Quietly, please.
caryatids: You looked up. Hardly anyone does. Shall I tell you about my sister?
solon-croesus: Sit, children. Tell me: who is the happiest person alive?
Think carefully. Richer people than you have got it wrong.
